Import entries.json into the database, or apply a reviewed migration plan

## Usage

    gournal migrate [options]

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `--plan <file>` | Reviewed migration plan (JSON) |  |
| `--dry-run` | Compute the changes and write nothing |  |
| `--diff <file>` | Write the dry-run diff (markdown) to this file |  |
